script.onScreen: Your character shows in the small moments. / A daily check-in on speech.
CHECK-IN / Listen to the end before you reply · Lower your voice when you disagree · Say thank you and please, even at home · Leave one argument unanswered · If it isn't good, let it stay unsaid
REFLECTION / Why it matters / Character is mostly built in moments nobody celebrates: a calm reply, a kind word, a silence that protects someone.
Good words, or silence. / Share this with your family

caption:
Your character shows in the moments nobody celebrates.

One test from Sahih al-Bukhari 6018: is it good? If not, keep quiet.

Swipe for five small ways to practise it today.

Share it with someone who may find it helpful.

📖 Sources
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6018 (Sahih, tr. Muhsin Khan) — sunnah.com/bukhari:6018
Full text: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day should not harm his neighbor, and anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day should entertain his guest generously and anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day should talk what is good or keep quiet. (i.e. abstain from all kinds of evil and dirty talk)
